text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — product asked us to lock the API surface for the Q3 inference release. Need a concrete proposal for function-calling + structured output behavior so SDKs can ship docs/examples.
Maria Lopez: Do we include rerank as a first-class route or keep it as a sample on top of embeddings? customer asks are leaning towards a simple sync rerank endpoint. :thinking_face:
Samir Patel: my vote: ship a dedicated rerank endpoint (POST /v1/rerank) for Q3, but keep embeddings.v1 stable. That reduces customer friction.
Julian Park: +1 for explicit rerank. For TS types we should expose a discriminated union for tool results vs model content. quick sketch: ```ts
type ModelMessage = { role: 'assistant'|'user'; content: string }
type ToolResult = { __type: 'tool'; name: string; output: unknown }
type Response = ModelMessage | ToolResult;
```
Julian Park: This makes structured-output parsing easier and avoids ad-hoc instanceof checks in apps.
Priya Nair: Docs side: we need 3 examples per language: minimal chat, function-calling with typed output, and rerank usage. Also a migration guide for anyone on older client methods.
Alex Chen: Migration policy — propose soft-deprecation: keep old method names for 6 months with warnings, then remove. Are we ok with that SLA?
Maria Lopez: Depends on internal testing windows. Product asked for 6 weeks of SDK stabilization before GA. If we do 6-month deprecation, ops can plan, but we need clear changelog entries.
Samir Patel: For Python client I'd like an ergonomic wrapper: ```py
# example
resp = client.chat.create(messages)
if resp.kind == 'tool':
    handle_tool(resp.name, resp.output)
else:
    print(resp.content)
```
Samir Patel: That paired with typed TS will cover cross-team needs.
Priya Nair: Changelog: entries should include deprecations, new endpoints (/v1/rerank), expanded function-calling schema, and examples added. We should add a PR template for docs that includes a "migration notes" checkbox.
Alex Chen: Launch checklist proposal (short): 1) API spec PR merged, 2) Python + TS SDK PRs merged, 3) examples + migration guide, 4) e2e tests for rerank and function-calling, 5) changelog drafted, 6) release notes + customer comms. Any missing items?
Maria Lopez: Add compatibility smoke tests against hosted models and a small perf budget estimate (latency + token cost) so sales can set expectations.
Julian Park: Also ensure types are exported in the published package (.d.ts + py-stubs). If we skip that, downstream types will break.
deploy-bot: Reminder: API spec freeze in 72 hours. Please tag spec PRs with #spec-freeze.
Alex Chen: OK assigning owners: API spec -> Maria, TS types + examples -> Julian, Python wrappers + examples -> Samir, Docs + changelog -> Priya. I'll own the rollback/fallback policies and customer comms.
Maria Lopez: I'll open the spec PR today with the rerank shape and function-calling payloads. Will include an examples dir and a /migration.md draft.
Samir Patel: I'll draft the Python wrapper and add unit tests for tool vs chat branches.
Julian Park: I'll write the TS discriminated unions and a tiny example repo showing typed function outputs.
Priya Nair: I'll add the changelog template + a docs PR checklist.
Alex Chen: Great — plan to review spec PR tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:
Maria Lopez: @Alex Chen noted. :eyes:
Priya Nair: Adding a customer-facing blurb draft after spec lands, will circulate for review.
Alex Chen: Thanks all — let's keep thread for updates only. If anyone hits a blocker ping here.
